Welcome to @Tier1Vet – Your Expert Guide to Pet Care!

🐾 Who We Are: Our team of licensed Alaskan veterinarians at @Tier1Vet provides trusted, comprehensive pet care advice. We specialize in helping you care for your cats and dogs, ensuring they live healthy, joyful lives.

🐶🐱 What We Offer: Join Drs. Sean and Sara McPeck for essential care tips, nutritional guidance, and expert answers to your pet health questions. We cover everything from basic pet care to complex health issues, focusing on practical, vet-approved solutions.

👩‍⚕️💡 Why Subscribe? Stay informed with the latest in pet health. Whether you’re a first-time pet owner or a seasoned pet lover, our channel is your go-to resource for all things pet wellness.

🐾 Join Our Community: Follow us for daily updates and become the best pet parent you can be. Learn to spot health issues early and keep your pets in top shape.

Subscribe to @Tier1Vet for expert pet care advice directly from the heart of Alaska!
